title: RetroArch 1.18.0: official stable release
summary: RetroArch published 1.18.0 on March 21, 2024. The release record documents an official stable release for the multi-system emulator project.

blocks.text: The RetroArch project published version 1.18.0 on March 21, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The GitHub record does not include an inline changelog. It identifies version 1.18.0, its publication date, and the official release page; those facts are retained here as the complete available release note.
